{{Quote|A shimmering wedding party appeared before us — a smiling Muun bride and her smiling Muun groom standing before ''the entire smiling Ralltiiri police force''."''<br />''"Lovely bride, I gulped.|[[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="LP" />}}
The '''bride''' of [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]]'s [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos's brother-in-law|brother-in-law]], both members of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was an inhabitant of the<ref name="LP" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. At some point in [[Gender/Legends|her]] life, she [[Marriage/Legends|married]] di Garthos's Muun brother and held a wedding party with the entire [[Ralltiiri police force]]. The curators of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]], di Garthos and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] called "[[Father (Rodian)|Father]]," had a [[Hologram/Legends|holo-recording]] of the wedding. When [[black marketeer]] [[Marn Hierogryph]] and accomplice [[Zayne Carrick]] tried to fence [[statuary]] artwork to the Obohn Gallery during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], di Garthos doubted the legitimacy of the duo and threatened to summon for his brother-in-law to arrest them, producing the holo-recording to back up his threat.<ref name="LP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The only appearance of di Garthos's brother-in-law's bride has been in the short story ''[[Labor Pains]]'' ([[2008]]) by [[John Jackson Miller]], in which she appeared in a hologram.
